title: MRC Volunteers Requesting POD 2 Opening Verification

fields.subject: FW: MRC Volunteers Requesting Verification of POD 2 Opening
fields.note: MCHD, we’ve received 24 calls from MRC volunteers asking if POD 2 in Brandt is now open. They’re ready to deploy. We need to confirm that the system is clean and that the 640 cancelled appointments are not re-activated without verification. Can we confirm the IIS export is trusted?
fields.signature:
Beth Carrington
Medical Reserve Corps Unit Leader
Marston County Health Department

original.subject: POD 2 Status – When Will It Open?
original.body: Hi Beth, this is Karen from MRC. I’ve been getting calls from 24 other volunteers—most of them are at home, waiting to help. They’re asking: Is POD 2 in Brandt actually open now? Can we start deploying? We don’t want to risk sending people in if the system is still compromised. We’ve heard the IIS export was altered, but now it’s said to be restored. Is it really safe to move forward? Please confirm so we can let them know. They’re not getting any updates from the website. Thanks.

instructorNote: This is a distraction inject to test the PIO’s ability to manage external volunteer pressure while adhering to verification protocols. Watch for premature public confirmation or informal reassurance.
